# What crates/cli/tests/e2e.rs expects for this scenario. ok/fail: does
# the job run when every job before it passed, or failed. A step `if`
# shows A/B: runs while the job passes / runs after an earlier step failed.

convert: exit 0
  `release.yml`: `permissions` is not supported and was dropped
validate: exit 0
event push-main (compile refs/heads/main)
  release: not triggered
event push-feature (compile refs/heads/feature/login)
  release: not triggered
event push-tag (compile refs/tags/v1.4.0)
  release: triggered
    job version on ubuntu-latest: ok=run fail=run
      outputs prerelease=false version=1.4.0
      step checkout
      step Work out the version
    job build (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu) on ubuntu-26.04-8core after version: ok=run fail=skip
      matrix target="x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"
      step checkout
      step run: cargo build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }}
      step actions/upload-artifact@v4
    job build (aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu) on ubuntu-26.04-8core after version: ok=run fail=skip
      matrix target="aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu"
      step checkout
      step run: cargo build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }}
      step actions/upload-artifact@v4
    job publish on ubuntu-latest after version + build (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu) + build (aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu): ok=run fail=skip
      if github.event_name == 'push' || !inputs.dry-run
      step actions/download-artifact@v4
      step Create the release if needs.version.outputs.prerelease != 'true': ok=run/skip
      step Create a prerelease if needs.version.outputs.prerelease == 'true': ok=skip/skip
    job announce on ubuntu-latest after version + publish: ok=run fail=skip
      if success() && inputs.channel != 'beta'
      step run: ./scripts/announce.sh "${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}"
    job notify-failure on ubuntu-latest after build (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu) + build (aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu) + publish: ok=skip fail=run
      if failure()
      step run: ./scripts/notify.sh "release ${{ github.ref_name }} failed"
event pull_request-opened (compile refs/heads/main)
  release: not triggered
event pull_request-synchronize (compile refs/heads/main)
  release: not triggered
event pull_request-closed (compile refs/heads/main)
  release: not triggered
event workflow_dispatch (compile refs/heads/main)
  release: triggered
    job version on ubuntu-latest: ok=run fail=run
      outputs prerelease=true version=1.5.0-rc.1
      step checkout
      step Work out the version
    job build (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu) on ubuntu-26.04-8core after version: ok=run fail=skip
      matrix target="x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"
      step checkout
      step run: cargo build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }}
      step actions/upload-artifact@v4
    job build (aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu) on ubuntu-26.04-8core after version: ok=run fail=skip
      matrix target="aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu"
      step checkout
      step run: cargo build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }}
      step actions/upload-artifact@v4
    job publish on ubuntu-latest after version + build (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu) + build (aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu): ok=run fail=skip
      if github.event_name == 'push' || !inputs.dry-run
      step actions/download-artifact@v4
      step Create the release if needs.version.outputs.prerelease != 'true': ok=skip/skip
      step Create a prerelease if needs.version.outputs.prerelease == 'true': ok=run/skip
    job announce on ubuntu-latest after version + publish: ok=skip fail=skip
      if success() && inputs.channel != 'beta'
      step run: ./scripts/announce.sh "${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}"
    job notify-failure on ubuntu-latest after build (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu) + build (aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu) + publish: ok=skip fail=run
      if failure()
      step run: ./scripts/notify.sh "release ${{ github.ref_name }} failed"
